en.headline: High Court ends 1991 hold-up trial after defendant dies of cancer
en.dek: The jury was discharged on Wednesday after Wen Wenye, 62, died in custody earlier in the week while the special hearing into the Sham Shui Po shooting was under way.
body: The High Court on Wednesday terminated the special hearing into a fatal 1991 armed robbery after the defendant, Wen Wenye, died in hospital earlier in the week.

Wen, a 62-year-old Shenzhen resident, had been found unfit to stand trial because of cognitive impairment caused by lung cancer. A seven-member jury had been asked only to decide whether he committed the acts alleged in the indictment arising from the June 1991 shooting at Shun Fat Company, a second-hand goods shop on Pei Ho Street in Sham Shui Po.

According to a government statement, Wen was found unconscious in a court holding cell during an adjournment and later died in hospital. The presiding judge discharged the jury on Wednesday. Cheng Kai-lam, a shop employee, was fatally shot during the botched hold-up; two other men involved remain unidentified.

zh.headline: 高等法院終止1991年深水埗劫殺案聆訊 被告病逝
zh.dek: 被告文穩業（62歲）早前因肺癌致認知障礙被裁定不適合答辯，本周在扣押期間昏迷後不治，法官周三解散陪審團。
body: 高等法院周三終止一宗涉及1991年致命持械劫案的特別聆訊，被告文穩業本周較早前在扣押期間病逝。
文穩業為深圳居民，因肺癌引致認知障礙，早前被裁定不適合答辯。七人陪審團原先只需裁定他是否作出控罪所指的行為，案件源於1991年6月深水埗北河街信發公司二手鐘錶行的槍擊事件。
政府聲明指，文穩業在案件休庭期間於法院扣留室被發現昏迷，其後送院不治。主審法官周三解散陪審團。店員工鄭啟霖在該次未遂劫案中中槍身亡，另外兩名涉案男子身份仍未確認。
